fallbacks.reason: Available full SVG is Sahara-era branding introduced after 2010; miniature has insufficient reuse rationale. Attempted sources: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Force_India.svg ; https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Mini_Free_Logo_Force_India.png

2016 W mark differs from AT&T Williams 2010 identity; tiny file has insufficient reuse rationale. Attempted sources: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Logo_Williams_F1.png ; https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Mini_Free_Logo_Williams.png

Sources are photographs of bodywork, not a clear standalone team mark; no verified reusable standalone 2010 logo located. Attempted sources: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Toro_Rosso_bodywork_2010.jpg ; https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Toro_rosso_detail07_1009833929.jpg

Both reusable candidates explicitly identify 2005–2012 branding, not the 2021 Red Bull Racing Honda identity. Attempted sources: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Red_Bull_Racing_-_2005_Logo.png ; https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Red_Bull_Racing_logo_ita.png

Found a licensed garage photograph, but no verified reusable standalone 2021 team logo; garage image is not counted as a logo. Attempted sources: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Alpha_Tauri_F1_Team_Garage,_British_GP,_Silverstone_2021_(51349514318).jpg ; https://commons.wikimedia.org/w/api.php?action=query&list=search&srsearch=%22AlphaTauri%22%20logo&srnamespace=6&format=json

2024 candidate has later branding; exact 2021 Cognizant candidate is absent. No verified reusable 2021 team mark located. Attempted sources: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Aston_Martin_F1_Team_logo_2024.jpg ; https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Aston_Martin_Cognizant_F1_Team_logo.svg

Stake candidate belongs to later identity; exact Racing candidate is absent. No verified reusable 2021 team mark located. Attempted sources: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:AlfaRomeoF1Stake.svg ; https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Alfa_Romeo_Racing_logo.svg
